outcome: Population-attributable risks (PAR) of risk factors for C-section
cohort: Pregnant women in Southwest Iran (n=4229) who gave birth between September 2012 and February 2013
finding: The study identified a high C-section rate (62.2%) in Southwest Iran, with family income, location of healthcare, and place of birth being the strongest contributors.
mod_finding: The study found a significant association between various socioeconomic and reproductive factors and the likelihood of C-section delivery.
